title: chrysanthemum roxburghii
intro: Chrysanthemum roxburghii, commonly known as the Yellow Chrysanthemum, is a flowering plant native to the mountainous regions of China, used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which are thought to be effective in treating a range of conditions, from fever and cough to arthritis and skin disorders. The bioactive constituents of Chrysanthemum roxburghii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal effects.
